description: Robust POSIX Shell and Bash scripting: strict error modes (set -euo pipefail), signal cleanup traps, robust CLI flag parsing with getopts, and variable quoting.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Robust POSIX Shell & Production Bash Scripting

Write resilient, defensive, and portable shell automation scripts that fail gracefully and clean up state deterministically.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Start every script with `set -euo pipefail` to abort on errors, unbound variables, and piped failures.
- Register cleanup functions via `trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM` for temporary file eradication.
- Quote every variable expansion (`"${VAR}"`) to prevent word splitting and glob expansion bugs.
- Parse options defensively using `getopts` and validate all user-supplied paths.
